name: senso-radar
description: Restaurant control from POS data: yesterday's numbers against the norm, deletions, refunds, cash shifts and stop-list — with the receipts behind every finding.

interface.longDescription:
Senso is a data layer for restaurant owners. It reads the restaurant's POS (iiko / Syrve today), cleans it, and checks every day against the restaurant's own norms — so ChatGPT answers from numbers Senso has already computed instead of adding up raw sales.

Ask how yesterday went, what needs attention this week, or why kitchen deletions went up. Senso shows a summary card (revenue vs the weekday norm, checks, average check, top signals) and a feed of findings: deletions after the kitchen ticket, refunds, emergency payment removals, cash shift discrepancies, stop-list losses, back-dated document edits. Open a finding to see who, when and which receipts — and open any receipt to see its timeline.

Read-only for the POS: Senso never writes to iiko / Syrve. A finding is a signal to check, not proof of wrongdoing. Data refreshes hourly; a new restaurant's first analysis takes up to a few hours.

Sign in with the same POS account you use in the Senso app, or open the demo restaurant without an account. Cards are in Russian; English is coming.
defaultPrompt: How did yesterday go in my restaurant?
What needs my attention this week?
Break down the biggest finding this week

positive.prompt: How did yesterday go in Gourmet Bistro?
positive.expected_behavior: A Senso summary card for yesterday: revenue compared with the weekday norm, number of checks, average check and up to three main signals. The text reply is a short takeaway in the user's language; figures come from Senso.

positive.prompt: What needs my attention this week in Gourmet Bistro?
positive.expected_behavior: A Senso feed card for the current week: findings with an amount and one line each, ordered by severity. Each finding has a button that opens its breakdown.

positive.prompt: Break down the kitchen deletions in Gourmet Bistro this week — who and why?
positive.expected_behavior: A breakdown of the finding about deletions after the kitchen ticket: facts, the norm, why it is a signal, staff and time slices, and receipt numbers that open the receipt.

positive.prompt: Show daily revenue in Gourmet Bistro for the last 14 days compared with the previous period.
positive.expected_behavior: Daily revenue for 14 days and the comparison with the previous 14 days, in the restaurant currency (USD for the demo), taken from Senso without recalculation.

positive.prompt: Is the Senso data for Gourmet Bistro complete and up to date?
positive.expected_behavior: Which data sources are fresh, when data was last updated, and which checks are unavailable with the reason.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Bali tomorrow?
Write a menu description for a new truffle pasta.

negative.description: Request to change POS data, which Senso cannot do
negative.prompt: Change the price of Big breakfast in iiko to $12.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. The full feed, finding breakdowns and receipts require a Senso subscription bought outside ChatGPT; without access the tools say a subscription is needed, with no purchase link.

publication.release_notes: First version: summary, feed of findings, finding breakdown with receipts, sales metrics and data health for restaurants on iiko / Syrve.

ru-RU.subtitle: Контроль ресторана по кассе
ru-RU.description:
Senso — слой данных ресторана. Читает кассу (сегодня iiko / Syrve), очищает данные и каждый день сверяет их с нормами самого ресторана, поэтому ChatGPT отвечает по цифрам, которые Senso уже посчитал.

Спросите, как прошёл вчерашний день, что проверить на этой неделе или почему выросли удаления после кухни. Senso покажет Сводку (выручка против нормы дня недели, чеки, средний чек, главные сигналы) и Ленту находок: удаления после отправки на кухню, возвраты, аварийные удаления оплат, расхождения кассы, потери от стоп-листа, правки документов задним числом. В разборе находки — кто, когда и какие чеки; любой чек открывается с хронологией.

Кассу Senso только читает. Находка — повод проверить, а не доказательство вины. Данные обновляются каждый час.

Вход — той же учётной записью кассы, что в приложении Senso, или демо-ресторан без учётной записи.
